known_limitations: The pipeline derives state from local assignment queue generation, completion records, review messages, launch queue documents, and validation artifacts; it does not create or modify governance state.
Copyable Codex commands are displayed for pending ready packages only and Codex submission remains manual.
pull_request_url is null until the PR is created.
pull_request_not_applicable_reason: Live PR metadata unavailable in local-first historical validation; completion evidence derived from repository artifacts.
summary: Added a Work Package Pipeline view to the Operations Center that groups pending, active, blocked, review-ready, completed, and missing-data states, enriches rows with title, mode, owner, dependencies, next action, completion/review status, and keeps ready Codex commands copyable for Steward launch workflow.
